action.prompt:
A file was just saved in Frank. Check it against these critical audio architecture rules from audio-architecture.md:

1. FRONTEND AUDIO RULE: Frontend files (*.tsx, *.ts under frontend/) must NEVER import or call audio processing libraries (librosa, pyrubberband, pedalboard, FFmpeg, Basic Pitch). The frontend only records and plays back. Flag any violation.

2. VERSIONING RULE: Any backend code (*.py) that writes a new audio file to storage must also create a version record. If you see a Supabase Storage upload without a corresponding version record creation, flag it.

3. KEY RULE: No API keys or secrets should appear as string literals anywhere. Flag any hardcoded key patterns.

4. ASYNC RULE: Backend routes that trigger audio processing (pitch correction, beat generation, mixing, mastering) must return a job_id and use the async_jobs system. A route that does heavy audio work synchronously will time out on Render's free tier. Flag any synchronous audio processing in route handlers.

If a violation is found, explain exactly what the problem is and suggest the fix. If no violations, say nothing.
